text:
alex: Heads-up — found a public Helm values.yaml in a partner repo that contains base64 KMS-wrapped blobs. Link: https://github.com/partner/repo/values.yaml
sec-bot: alert: public file contains wrapped secrets matching keyring 'redwood-prod-keys' (ciphertext hash abc123...). Flagging as potential credential exposure.
maria: Can you paste the first ~12 chars of one ciphertext blob (no full secret)?
alex: first blob starts with `CiQA...==` (I redacted the rest). It's wrapped format we use.
jordan: If that's our key we need containment asap. Priority: 1) stop further public exposure, 2) ensure key can't be abused, 3) plan rewrap/rotation. ops-oncall can you run a repo-wide scan for mirrors/forks?
ops-oncall: ACK. Starting a quick scan across org+public forks for matching blob fingerprints. Will also attempt takedown with partner if mirrored. ETA ~10m.
sam: Caution: do not revoke the KMS key outright without a rewrap plan — some services depend on it. Proposed flow: create temporary key, rewrap all wrapped values to temp key, update Vault/transit config, then retire old key.
taylor: Agreed. Rough rewrap commands (example placeholders):
```
# list keys (example)
# gcloud kms keys versions list --keyring=redwood-prod-keys --location=global
# rewrap (example)
# gcloud kms encrypt --key=temporary-key --plaintext-file=secret.dec --ciphertext-file=secret.rewrapped
```
Adapt to whatever cloud KMS the key lives in.
maria: Also enable/verify audit logging on KMS + Vault now (if not already), and add a quick SIEM rule for these ciphertext signatures. ops-oncall can you enable and confirm?
ops-oncall: Enabling Vault audit device -> syslog right now (done). KMS admin audit scheduled via cloud console (propagating, should be active in ~5m). SIEM rule queued and will pick up matching hashes.
alex: Partner removed the mirror and acknowledged the leak. I opened a PR to remove the file from their repo and DM'd their infra contact — they accepted and removed the mirror. PR: https://github.com/partner/repo/pull/42
jordan: Action items (assign):
- A) Enumerate all wrapped blob IDs & where they are referenced -> alex + jordan
- B) Rewrap plan and runbook -> sam + taylor
- C) RBAC audit: who has wrap/unwrap permission for that key -> maria + eng-sre
- D) Short postmortem & comms draft -> sec-ops
- E) Decide customer notification (legal/communications) -> jordan to coordinate
sec-bot: ticket created SECBOT-8342 (P2) linking this thread and the repo PR.
maria: I'll take RBAC audit. Alex please upload the enumerated blob list to SECBOT-8342. Ops, update when KMS audit is fully active.
alex: Uploading list to the ticket now, incl fingerprints + repo paths.
ops-oncall: KMS audit logs are now visible in logging console (started ~3m ago). Continuing scans for copies.
maria: Thanks — I'll run a quick entitlement prune proposal after I have the full list.
sec-bot: reminder scheduled in 24h to follow up on rewrap completion & postmortem.
alex: Thanks team. Will update SECBOT-8342 with timeline for rewrap once Sam/Taylor share runbook.
